capabilities: Load Geoapify map styles, glyphs, sprites, and tiles
Resolve search terms to place suggestions and coordinates
Build routes between waypoints and reachability isochrones
Snap recorded tracks to the road or path network
disambiguation: Not a standalone map plugin; it only works as a provider for the Places plugin.
extras: The README documents only network requests and code dependencies (maplibre-gl, places-shared, places-maplibre-base); setup and usage details are absent, and Obsidian staff have not manually reviewed the plugin.
intentEvidence: Map provider for Places using Geoapify
problem: The Places plugin needs an external map provider to render maps and run location services such as search, routing, and elevation.
